in_english.name: Mohid
in_english.meaning: One who acknowledges the oneness of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mohid originates from the Arabic root 'W-H-D', which signifies unity and oneness. In Islamic tradition, Mohid refers to one who affirms and worships the oneness of God (Allah). This name holds spiritual significance as it reflects the fundamental Islamic belief in Tawhid, or the oneness of God. Historically, the name Mohid has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a strong connection to Islamic faith and values
